resources.string: Each beat flashes a new colour, then fades.
Colour follows the sound: bass is red, high notes are blue and violet.
Keeps your strip\'s colour. Brightness follows how loud the music is.
A slow colour drift that breathes with the music. Good for background music.
Finds the tempo, then keeps the lights on the beat, even in quiet parts and breaks.
Start music sync to find the beat.
Tap 4 times or more on the beat to set the tempo. If the lights go twice too fast or too slow, use ×2 or ÷2.
One colour per tempo. The colour stays until the song changes, and each tempo has its own colour.
Keeps the strip\'s colour from before music started. Only the brightness follows the beat.
Fine-tune if the lights come before or after the beat. Higher makes them later.
Measuring the delay with the microphone…
Play some music near your phone, then start.
Play music on your phone, then start.
Follows what your phone plays, like Spotify or YouTube. Android asks you to share your screen: only the sound is used.
Listens to the room. Use it for a speaker or another device.
No audio captured. The playing app may block capture. Try the microphone.
Music sync did not start: phone audio sharing was not allowed.
Music sync stopped: phone audio sharing ended.
Music sync stopped: phone audio could not be captured.
Sound is analysed on your phone. It is never recorded or sent anywhere.

To make your strips follow the music, fff3 listens to the room through the microphone. Sound is analysed on your phone, never recorded or sent anywhere.\n\nAndroid may also ask to show a notification. It lets you stop music sync without opening the app.

To capture what your phone plays, Android asks for the audio recording permission. fff3 only uses it to analyse the sound on your phone. It is never recorded or sent anywhere.\n\nAndroid may also ask to show a notification. It lets you stop music sync without opening the app.
Music sync needs the audio recording permission, even for phone audio. You can allow it in the app settings.
Music sync stopped: the microphone is not available. Another app may be using it.
Music sync stopped: the microphone permission was removed.
Music sync stopped: the strips are out of reach or were removed.
Music sync stopped: Bluetooth is off.
Music sync stopped: fff3 needs the Nearby devices permission.
Shown while your strips follow the music.
Your strips follow the music the phone hears.
Your strips follow the music your phone plays.
